info.title: Extreme Platform ONE REST API - Subscriptions & Licensing
info.description:
The Extreme Platform ONE™ License API provides comprehensive management of
software licenses, subscriptions, and entitlements across your Extreme network
infrastructure, enabling centralized visibility and control over all licensing
aspects from trial activation through operational management.

**🔑 License & Entitlement Management:**

• **License Summary & Details** - Centralized dashboard view of all licenses
with health status indicators, expiration tracking, and utilization metrics
across applications

• **Entitlement Tracking** - Complete visibility into license entitlements
with filtering by application, license type, and status for effective
license inventory management

• **License Synchronization** - On-demand synchronization with Extreme Portal
to ensure license information is current and accurate

• **License Reporting** - Exportable reports for compliance auditing,
capacity planning, and license utilization analysis


**🔗 Portal Integration:**

• **Extreme Portal Linking** - Seamless account linking between ExtremeCloud IQ
and Extreme Portal for automated license provisioning and management

• **Partner Portal Integration** - MSP and partner account linking for
multi-tenant license management and entitlement distribution

• **Legacy Entitlement Migration** - Tools for managing and migrating
legacy license entitlements to the current licensing model


**⚡ Advanced License Operations:**

• **Trial License Requests** - Self-service trial license provisioning
for evaluating Extreme platform capabilities

• **NAC Entitlement Allocation** - Granular allocation of Network Access
Control licenses across organizational units

• **Credit Activation** - AI credit and service credit activation for
consumption-based services


**🏢 MSP & Enterprise Support:**

Built for service providers and enterprises with multi-tenant license
management, hierarchical entitlement distribution, and comprehensive
audit trails for license compliance and governance.

get.description: Retrieves the license settings for this account, including the default trial subscription period in days.
Retrieves the catalog of supported license types, optionally filtered by application. Returns license type metadata including names and descriptions for each license type.
Retrieves the shared CUID and legacy entitlements information, as well as portal link related information.

post.description: Generates a link_url for initiating the ExtremeCloud IQ account linking process with an Extreme Portal account. The request body url field specifies the callback URL to redirect the user to after the linking process is complete. The user must use the link_url returned in the response to navigate to the Extreme Portal and authenticate, which initiates the account linking process.

Disconnects the ExtremeCloud IQ account from the linked Extreme Portal account. After unlinking, license synchronization will stop and you will need to re-link to access portal-based license management.

Establishes a connection between your ExtremeCloud IQ account and an Extreme Partner Portal account. This integration enables partners to manage customer licenses, access partner-specific pricing, and streamline license provisioning workflows.

requestBody.description: Link Extreme partner portal account request payload

200.description: Link Extreme partner portal account response

get.description: Retrieves the list of current applications and their license status for the VIQ. Optionally filter by specific application IDs to retrieve targeted application information.

parameters.name: applicationIds
parameters.description: List of application names to filter by

get.description: Retrieves license entitlements with optional filtering by application, keyword search, and quick filter options. Results can be grouped by application for organized viewing. Use simpleView to populate the license_details section for each license_type.

parameters.name: groupByApp
parameters.description: Whether group by app, if app is null, groupByApp will be false

parameters.name: keyword
parameters.description: The keyword to filter, will search the license type and license description

parameters.name: simpleView
parameters.description: Show simple view with license details without group by and quickfilter options

get.description: Retrieves detailed information for licenses of a specific type, including individual license keys, activation dates, expiration dates, and current status. Use quickFilter to filter by health status (current, future, or expiring).

parameters.name: licenseType
parameters.description: The license type identifier (product_feature name, not the display name). The correct value can be obtained from the license_type field in the listEntitlements response.

parameters.name: sharedCuid
parameters.description: Customer Unique Identifier used for MSP admin to view license details across multiple license accounts

put.description: Updates or sets a custom note for a specific license entitlement. Notes can be used to track internal references, deployment locations, cost centers, or any other relevant metadata for license organization and management.

requestBody.description: The payload to set license entitlement note

get.description: Generates and downloads a license report as a ZIP file. Reports can be filtered by application, keyword, and license status. Useful for compliance auditing, capacity planning, and license inventory documentation.

parameters.name: groupByApp
parameters.description: Whether group by application, if app is null, groupByApp will be false

parameters.name: keyword
parameters.description: The keyword to filter, will search the license type and license description

parameters.name: sharedCuid
parameters.description: The shared Customer Unique Identifier (CUID) to filter licenses for a specific License Account

schema.description: Binary data of the license report ZIP file

post.description: Triggers an on-demand synchronization of license information from Extreme Portal. Use this to refresh license data after purchasing new licenses or when license status appears out of date.
Submits a request for trial licenses to evaluate Extreme platform features. Trial licenses are time-limited and provide full functionality for the specified applications during the evaluation period.

requestBody.description: The payload to request trial license

200.description: Trial license request submitted successfully. The trial period begins immediately and lasts for the configured number of trial days for the specified application.

get.description: Retrieves the current allocation of Network Access Control (NAC) license entitlements across organizational units. Shows how NAC licenses are distributed and consumed.

put.description: Configures the allocation of Network Access Control (NAC) license entitlements across organizational units. Allows redistribution of NAC licenses based on organizational needs.

requestBody.description: The payload to set NAC entitlement allocations

200.description: NAC entitlement allocations have been successfully updated. The allocations are applied to the specified XIQ Site Engine appliances by serial number and percentage.

get.description: Retrieves statistics for Network Access Control (NAC) license entitlements. Returns metrics of total number of NAC licenses and the number of available NAC licenses to help monitor NAC deployment and capacity planning.

post.description: Adds a legacy entitlement key to the account. Legacy entitlement keys are no longer supported in ExtremeCloud IQ (XIQ) and Wireless Switching (WS) products. This endpoint is deprecated and will be removed in a future release. Please use the standard license activation workflow instead.

requestBody.description: The payload to add legacy entitlement key

delete.description: Removes a legacy entitlement from the account by its ID. Legacy entitlement keys are no longer supported in ExtremeCloud IQ (XIQ) and Wireless Switching (WS) products. This endpoint is deprecated and will be removed in a future release.

get.description: Retrieves enterprise agreement contract information with associated license types grouped by application from downstream service.

Retrieves license entitlements for a specific MSP customer. Returns license details including types, quantities, expiration dates, and usage status. Supports filtering by application, keyword search, and quick filter options. This endpoint is deprecated - use the standard entitlements endpoint with MSP context instead.

ClicsLicenseHealthColor.description: Visual indicator of license health status. GREEN indicates healthy licenses with no issues. YELLOW indicates warnings such as approaching expiration. RED indicates critical issues requiring immediate attention.

ClicsTrialLicenseStatus.description: Current status of a trial license request. NOT_REQUESTED means no trial initiated. REQUESTED indicates pending approval. REJECTED means trial was denied. TRIALING indicates active trial period. EXPIRED means trial has ended.

ClicsAppItem.description: Application license information including health status and trial license eligibility. Can represent a specific application or a global aggregate across all applications.

global.description: Whether it is an item for all applications

allOf.description: The application identifier, valid when global is false

app_name.description: The application display name which can be displayed to users such as SD-WAN, XCloudIQ etc, valid when global is false

can_request_trial_license.description: Whether trial license can be requested

ClicsLicenseQuickFilter.description: Predefined filter options for quickly filtering licenses by status or expiration timeframe. ALL shows everything, CURRENT shows active licenses, FUTURE shows upcoming licenses, and expiration filters show licenses expiring within the specified days.

ClicsLicenseHealthState.description: Indicates the health state of a license. EXPIRED means the license has ended. INACTIVE means not yet active. EXPIRING indicates approaching expiration. TRIAL_EXPIRING means trial period ending soon. ACTIVE_GRACE_PERIOD is post-expiration grace. EXPIRING_ZERO_ACTIVATION means expiring with no activations. TRIAL_EXPIRED indicates trial has ended.

ClicsLicenseStatus.description: Comprehensive license status information including health indicators, visual state representation, and descriptive messaging for display purposes.

param1.description: The count of activated licenses for various license health states.

param2.description: The number of days for various license health states.

metered_by.description: Indicates how the license is metered. Examples include DEVICE (per-device count), USER (per-user count), or BANDWIDTH (data throughput).

param1.description: The count of activated licenses for various license health states.
